name: Gloom Weed
summary: In Tirisfal, Gloom Weed grows between Deathknell and Brill. Gordo gathers it by mistake while searching for doom weed.

sections.title: A Mistaken Harvest
sections.body:
Gloom Weed grows west of Brill and east of Solliden Farmstead. It is harmless and lacks the alchemical strength sought by the Royal Apothecary Society. Gordo, a lumbering abomination, wanders the road, pulling weeds with clumsy hands. He misunderstood his master's orders, so he keeps gathering the wrong plant.

Then Gordo asks travelers to carry the weeds to Master Holland in the Brill graveyard. The apothecary is annoyed by the mistake.

faq.q: What is Gloom Weed used for?
faq.answer: Forsaken alchemists have little use for Gloom Weed. Gordo gathers it because he mistakes it for doom weed, the herb his master requested.
Gloom Weed grows in Tirisfal Glades between Brill and Deathknell. Find it along the road and in meadows east of Solliden Farmstead.

faq.q: Who is Gordo and why is he picking it?
faq.answer: Gordo is an abomination sent by Master Holland to gather reagents. His hands are clumsy and his mind is simple, so he pulls the wrong plants and asks passersby to help him.

faq.q: What did Master Holland actually want?
faq.answer: Master Holland needs doom weed for his experiments in the Brill graveyard. When travelers bring him Gloom Weed, he scoffs at the mistake and sends them to gather the herb he needs.

angles.text: As a trained herbalist, you can sense Gloom Weed with Find Herbs and spot it more easily in Tirisfal's shadowy undergrowth.
As a Forsaken newly departed from Deathknell, you can learn from fetching Gloom Weed how poorly abominations work and how sharply Undercity alchemists speak.
